SAMPLE DATA

Samples affect totals, reports and backups and can sync to a team. By default the sample receipt stays on this device. Samples cannot create account-confirmed handovers. Clearing is blocked if your records depend on samples.

Shared test receipts remain in Firestore after clearing samples. Permanent workspace deletion is not available yet.

Team refund requests, handover records and shared receipt images may not be included. Download shared receipts separately.

Review offline data

Copy records from this device’s separate offline tracker to the workspace you have open. Review additions and choose between conflicting versions before confirming.

Nothing is deleted automatically. Organization details and settings are not copied; records with different IDs may still be duplicates. Team changes need a connection and sync confirmation. Other embedded images remain device-only; refund records with local receipt images cannot yet be copied to a team.

What’s new

Workspace and appearance improvements

  • Quick action search recognizes form purposes, and its Enter shortcut no longer repeats into a newly opened form.
  • Team management groups workspace and member details, with create, find and invite actions in compact dialogs.
  • Workspace owners can preview team icons and colors instantly, with matching icons in the workspace switcher.
  • Contribution activity details use a calmer emerald and slate layout; the floating Quick action appears for touch and hides when keyboard use is detected.
  • Dialogs share a softer glass-inspired appearance, and the floating plus opens Quick action with an inline suggestion as you type.
  • Quick action helps you find a form, check fund balances or prepare statements from any workspace.
  • The desktop sidebar now shows your fund cash balance. Pondo Artwork is more visible on True black backgrounds.
  • Workspace actions now sit below the headers, giving the illustrations a dedicated space at every screen size.
  • Workspace headers share a clearer style and clay-inspired graphics, with a compact sidebar. Account statements are now in Financial Statements alongside cash reports.
  • Navigate sections and presentations with horizontal trackpad swipes or mouse dragging; bottom-sheet handles also support desktop gestures on narrow screens.
  • Choose True black in Appearance for deep-black surfaces and subtle black-based backgrounds. Choose White for a solid black background.
  • Prepare a read-only account statement from selected workspace records, with a separate refund section and print or Save as PDF.
  • The welcome screen has a refreshed frosted-glass design, clearer sign-in buttons and the same separate offline tracker.
  • The notification menu has compact filters, clearer unread alerts and an expandable browser-alert settings section.
  • Reviewer access is shown as a compact expandable indicator instead of covering the page.
  • Team collaboration settings have a clearer layout for workspace appearance, discovery, invitations and members.
  • Browse fund and contribution cards with new rail controls and compact summaries on Overview.
  • Overview has clearer balance, period and recent-activity cards; totals still include all recorded dates.
  • Switch workspaces with a clearer, keyboard-friendly menu and a confirmation after a successful switch.
  • Reuse saved Other Funds purposes and explore receipt summaries by purpose on Overview and the Other Funds page.
  • Accent colors now personalize navigation, controls and previews with improved contrast in light and dark modes.
  • Present a clearer workspace overview with separate donation and Other Funds balances, refund and contribution summaries, and scoped fund slides.
  • Existing sample sets can add missing Other Funds examples without clearing other records.
  • Sample data now includes multiple examples across the available financial forms, including Other Funds.
  • Record Other Funds teacher payments separately and request a two-person, account-confirmed handover with a printable acknowledgment.
  • Funds has a simpler shared layout and a shortcut to transaction history, while keeping each fund separate.
  • Transactions has compact filters, cleaner rows and a streamlined details dialog.
  • Transaction names open full record details, with alternating row colors for easier scanning.
  • Fund cards use a compact layout and automatic rotating colors.
  • Donation receipts now have a searchable table with 20 receipts per page.
  • Donation fund cards now match the Funds page layout on desktop and mobile.
  • Transactions brings fund activity, contribution payments and refund requests into a searchable history without changing balances.
  • Record individual cash donations in a chosen donation fund, save and add another, and review or print receipts.
  • Refund forms now distinguish personal reimbursements from unpaid supplier bills, with clearer itemized entries.
  • Edit the description, source and date of individual regular-fund income entries, with corrections kept in history.
  • Fund details now offer a Fund settings dialog for descriptions, opening details and deletion.
  • Owners can update a shared workspace display name; the original registered search name stays the same.
  • Refunds can include item quantities and unit prices, with a calculated total.
  • Workspace lists stay steady while membership checks finish or a connection is interrupted.
  • Refunds can link a recipient to a team member for clearer transparency review.
  • My refund requests shows account-linked payments and reversals without creating extra expenses.
  • In wide landscape layouts, Needs your review appears at the top of the activity column.
  • Overview now focuses on the review queue, with requester photos and clearer action colors. Cash and refund comparison is in Refunds.
  • Pay approved refunds without a project using uncommitted fund cash; project allocations remain protected.
  • Approved refunds stay unpaid while awaiting funding, with clearer funding guidance.
  • While Pondo is open, alerts show an in-app banner and can play your selected app sound. Android system alerts use the app service worker when supported.
  • Active member refund requests now highlight the submitter with a profile photo when available.
  • Refund requests are consolidated, and viewers are notified when a recent member request is rejected.
  • On sign-in, confirmed workspaces referenced by your requests are restored to your list when missing.
  • Confirmed member refund requests now appear in dashboard counts and the approver review queue, with a notification for owners and disbursing officers.
  • Recognize due and overdue reminders, refunds, and financial activity with category icons where supported. Attributed team updates may show member photos.
  • Follow a clearer Death Aid path from creating a record through payments, review, printing and handover.
  • Rotate your device to use Pondo in portrait or landscape when supported.
  • Team alerts show member profiles when available and open the relevant workspace.
  • Long contribution and other office-style reports now continue across pages instead of being cut off when printed from a dialog.
  • See recently active team members in a stacked profile view when connected. Presence is approximate.
  • Messenger and Instagram in-app browsers now show guidance to open invitation links in Chrome or Safari.
  • Expand the names field when adding contributors in bulk.
  • Use the resize handle on supported devices to choose a comfortable size.
  • Contributor cards on phones have clearer balances, easy-to-reach actions and persistent filters.
  • The desktop contributor table keeps its headings visible while scrolling, and the top bar adapts better to narrow windows.
  • Record cash donations in donation funds, track their use and find receipts in the Funds register.
  • Track Death Aid personal contributions and prepare BaPSTEA remittance reports.
